meanings.note: Secondary conversational sense ('platter') (large flat serving dish) used in spoken Russian dialogue.

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.

meanings.note: Проводить время = to spend time.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: Neuter главное, used as a noun. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('main, most important').

meanings.note: Used for women too. From Latin 'director' (one who guides or manages, from 'dirigere', to direct).

examples.trans: I want to talk to the director.

examples.text: Я один раз позвонила как директор и отменила контрольную.
examples.trans: Once I phoned pretending to be the headmistress and cancelled a test.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + dative. Core Russian prep meaning 'to, towards' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

examples.text: Ну что ты молчишь? Ты толстый, ты не спортсмен!
examples.trans: Well, why are you so quiet? You're fat, you're no athlete!

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'one', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Surprise, fright or pain.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.

meanings.note: подать подписи = to submit signatures
Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'дать').

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'звать').
